title: Potassium You Treat Now, and When You Dialyze

questions.stem: The 2025 emergency-care chapter on hyperkalemia is written for:
questions.explanation: Those recommendations are for arrest. They do not prove that calcium improves survival.

questions.stem: In that arrest chapter, intravenous calcium:

options.text: Has limited evidence of a survival benefit

questions.explanation: Do not tell a family that calcium is a proven save in arrest.

questions.stem: Adult hyperkalemia in that chapter is a potassium:
questions.explanation: Adult hyperkalemia is above 5.0. Severe hyperkalemia in hospitalized adults is described as above 6.5.
Watching the tracing is not the same as lowering the number.

questions.stem: Outside arrest, the shift with evidence for lowering serum potassium is:

options.text: A repeat lab in the morning

questions.explanation: The pooled change is about 0.7 per liter. Give glucose so the sugar does not crash. The shift is temporary.

questions.stem: KDIGO says to start renal replacement emergently when:

options.text: The creatinine hits a chosen number
Life-threatening changes in fluid, electrolyte, and acid-base balance exist

questions.explanation: That is recommendation 5.1.1. A single creatinine or urea is not the trigger.

questions.stem: Recommendation 5.1.2 says the dialysis decision should:

options.text: Use the broader picture, not a single creatinine or urea

questions.explanation: Trends and the clinical picture matter more than one number.

questions.stem: When the kidneys are not working and shift medicines are used up, extra potassium leaves by:
questions.explanation: That is why a morning recheck is the wrong plan for a wide QRS that is not responding.

questions.stem: A wide QRS with a potassium of 6.8 should be:

options.text: Repeated in the morning before any treatment
Ignored if the creatinine is only mildly up
Treated with calcium alone and then forgotten

questions.explanation: The emergency is the heart and a number that will not come down.

options.text: When to dialyze a life-threatening electrolyte change
Insulin with glucose as a temporary shift

questions.explanation: The ketoacidosis potassium lesson and the tubule lesson are separate.
